tool_schemas.name: generateImage
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new image-generation job for the authenticated account using the provided request payload (applying service defaults for any omitted optional fields), enqueues it for execution, and returns the created job record (including its job_id/status) with the input persisted for later retrieval/auditing. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if api_key is missing, malformed, revoked, or does not match an active account; FORBIDDEN if the key lacks permission to create generation jobs; and TOO_MANY_REQUESTS if the account or key has exceeded its job-creation quota/rate limits. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing (e.g., prompt), unknown fields are provided, or any parameter violates constraints (e.g., width/height < 64, num_images not in 1–10, steps < 1, guidance_scale < 0, output_format not in {png,jpeg,webp}, or callback_url is not a valid URI).

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request (raw secret key string).

body.description: Image generation request payload; stored on the job as input and used to run the provider.

prompt.description: Text prompt describing the image to generate.

negative_prompt.description: Text describing what to avoid in the generated image.

width.description: Requested output image width in pixels.

height.description: Requested output image height in pixels.

num_images.description: Number of images to generate for this job.

steps.description: Number of sampling/denoising steps to run.

guidance_scale.description: Prompt guidance strength (higher usually adheres more to the prompt).

style.description: Optional style preset name understood by the provider.

callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL to notify when the job finishes.

metadata.description: Optional client-provided metadata to attach to the job input.

tool_schemas.name: getCurrentIdentity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated identity for the provided API key, including the owning account, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the api_key is missing, malformed, revoked, or belongs to a non-active account.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request (raw secret key string).

tool_schemas.name: listGenerationJobs
tool_schemas.description: Lists generation jobs visible to the authenticated account, optionally filtered by status and time range, ordered by created_at desc. Returns a paginated result set; refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the api_key is invalid/revoked or the account is not active.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request (raw secret key string).

created_after.description: Optional filter: include jobs created at or after this timestamp (inclusive).

created_before.description: Optional filter: include jobs created before this timestamp (exclusive).

page_size.description: Maximum number of jobs to return per page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: getGenerationJob
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single generation job by id for the authenticated account, including persisted input and execution metadata. Refuses NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist for the caller, and UNAUTHORIZED if the api_key is invalid/revoked or the account is not active.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request (raw secret key string).

tool_schemas.name: cancelGenerationJob
tool_schemas.description: Requests cancellation of a queued or running generation job owned by the authenticated account by transitioning its status to cancelled. Returns the updated job record; refuses CONFLICT if the job is already terminal (succeeded/failed/cancelled) or cannot transition per lifecycle rules, and refuses NOT_FOUND/UNAUTHORIZED as applicable.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request (raw secret key string).

tool_schemas.name: listGeneratedImages
tool_schemas.description: Lists generated image artifacts for the authenticated account, optionally filtered by job_id and status, ordered by created_at desc. Returns a paginated result set; refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the api_key is invalid/revoked or the account is not active.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request (raw secret key string).

job_id.description: Optional filter: only images produced by the specified generation job id.

page_size.description: Maximum number of images to return per page.

page_token.description: Opaque pagination token returned from a previous call.

tool_schemas.name: getGeneratedImage
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single generated image artifact by id for the authenticated account, including storage metadata (content_type, byte_size, dimensions, and storage locator). Refuses NOT_FOUND if the image does not exist for the caller or is deleted, and refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the api_key is invalid/revoked or the account is not active.

api_key.description: API key used to authenticate the request (raw secret key string).

metadata.name: Jimeng AI Image Generation Server
metadata.description: This backend stores accounts, API keys, image generation jobs, and generated image artifacts for the Jimeng AI Image Generation Server.
